Hi Laura,

Following our intake call, Im attaching the artefacts you requested to demonstrate how we handle background checks, training, and deprovisioning for personnel relevant to the SOC 2 fieldwork. The files are all in the S3 bundle below (link expires one week after upload):

- bg_checks_redacted.zip (contains redacted background checks; see manifest for redaction notes)
- onboarding_deprovision_runbook_v3.pdf (playbook + scripts for account deprovisioning)
- chain_of_custody_manifest_20260630.txt (signed manifest enumerating file hashes and access events)
- signed_affidavit_naomi_20260630.pdf (statement confirming redaction process and custody)

S3 link: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/rw-inference-audit/bg_checks_redacted.zip?X-Amz-Expires=604800
KMS key used for server-side encryption: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234-efgh-5678

  9f86d081...  onboarding_deprovision_runbook_v3.pdf
  e3b0c442...  chain_of_custody_manifest_20260630.txt

A few contextual notes:
- Background checks were performed by our vendor (Greenbank Screening) between 2024-2026; personally identifiable fields were redacted per our SOC 2 redaction policy before export. Redaction notes are in the manifest with field-level hashes.
- The runbook includes automation (AWS IAM role revocation, GSuite deprovision hooks, and key rotation steps). Execution logs for sample separations are included in the manifest index.
- The chain_of_custody_manifest is signed by me and lists the S3 Put/GET events we retained; we can also provide CloudTrail excerpts if you need raw event details.

Please confirm whether the attached manifest + signed affidavit satisfy the auditors requirement for "documented custody and redaction". If you need notarized affidavits or a different hash algorithm, let me know and Ill escalate to Legal.

Thanks,

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the manifest excerpt — looks like the right material at a glance. A few follow-ups before we close the SOC 2 checklist item:

1) Please paste the full manifest content (file name + SHA256) directly into the body of an email or provide the DocuSign-signed manifest link so we can verify signatures without downloading the full bundle.
2) Well need a short statement (1-2 lines) describing the redaction process and who performed redaction (vendor vs. internal) for chain-of-custody traceability.
3) Can you also provide sample deprovisioning execution timestamps (UTC) for 3 recent separations and corresponding CloudTrail GetBucket/delete events so we can confirm deletion workflows?

Finally, is the signed_affidavit_naomi_20260630.pdf countersigned or notarized? If not, a DocuSign traceable signature is usually sufficient, but the audit team will flag it if we cant validate the signature origin.

If we have those items by COB Friday (2026-07-03), we can mark this control as evidence-complete for the period.

Best,
Laura
Senior Auditor, ComplyCorp Audit Services
audits@complycorp.com

---
